<observations>
Date: May 22 - May 31, 2026
* 🔴 User profile: Emergency fund target is $24,000; never owned individual stocks, only 401(k) index funds.
* 🔴 Savings & Automation: Aiming to increase monthly savings by $300; established automatic transfers ($250 to money market/HYSA, $180 to Roth IRA).
* ✅ Debt & Mortgage: Allocated funds to Visa credit card, student loans, and credit card debt (saving $1,200 and $950 in interest respectively); analyzed mortgage refinancing to 3.1% rate (saving $85/mo).
* ✅ Tax & Financial Planning: Delivered summaries for charitable and medical deductions; estimated $420 Roth IRA tax savings; reviewed HSA options and year-end/quarterly bonus allocations (Solo 401(k)); recommended CapitalOne HYSA (2.1% APY) for vacation savings.

Date: Jun 4 - Jun 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User asked whether allocating upcoming $300 tax refund to HSA maximizes tax benefits (noted 2026 family cap is $3,850).
* 🔴 (09:05) User set aside $150/month for a Costa Rica vacation fund for next summer.
* 🟡 (11:00) Agent ran cash-flow sensitivity analysis incorporating a $1,200 car insurance premium due in July.
* ✅ (11:40) Projected that vacation and HSA contributions can raise the emergency fund by $1,200 within six months.
* 🔴 (12:15) User requested suggestions for a low-fee index fund to diversify beyond current 401(k) holdings.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent drafted an email template for the user to request a reduced APR from their major credit card issuer.
* ✅ (15:20) Updated 12-month cash-flow model to include vacation savings and HSA contributions.
* 🔴 (19:10) User stated their tax filing extension ends in ten days on June 18, 2026.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Provide suggestions for a low-fee index fund to diversify beyond current 401(k) holdings.
- Secondary: Acknowledge the upcoming tax filing extension deadline on June 18, 2026.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
Provide recommendations for low-fee index funds to help the user diversify their portfolio beyond their current 401(k) holdings.
</suggested-response>
